children: CrowdStrike expanded its partnership with OpenAI, extending its enterprise security to artificial-intelligence agents and bringing advanced cyber-reasoning capabilities to its Falcon platform.
Both moves will help enable customers to adopt AI with confidence, as well as assess risk and prioritize action with greater speed, precision and scale, the companies said Wednesday.

CrowdStrike said it will secure AI agents at the point of execution with Falcon Guardian, an AI detection-and-response solution that will help organizations understand agent activity, detect compromised or unauthorized behavior, and respond before threats spread.
Crowdstrike said it will also bring OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Cyber to the Falcon platform, harnessing frontier AI to assess and act on risk at machine speed.
